purpose: Mesh-derived AO and optional selected-to-active tangent normal transfer with mip-safe UV-padding preflight
limitations: Runtime backend: Blender 4.3+ Cycles CPU. Explicit local installation; no automatic downloads.

Bake preflight requires unique UVs and enough measured padding to retain at least one pixel after the first 2x mip reduction; deeper safe levels are conservatively reported, not universally guaranteed.
This does not prove target-engine sampler behavior, anisotropic filtering, compression behavior or every possible mip level.
Bounded technical evidence only. No automatic product or artistic acceptance.
